# Version 3.119.3
> **Servicing preview reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.3-preview.1.1)

> **Superseded by [3.119.4](3.119.4.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.4.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.3-preview.1 improves Linux ARM64 and ahead-of-time application reliability. It also refreshes bundled image and text dependencies for the 3.119 servicing line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux ARM64 and AOT crashes fixed** — Packages the required fontconfig runtime for Linux ARM64 and fixes applications built with reflection disabled. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494), [#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates bundled libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and related native dependency sources. ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.4

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
